expectations.text: The screening model does not use any 'Curricular units 2nd sem' column as a feature (they are recorded after the end-of-first-semester decision point)
expectations.evidence: notes.md: 6 'Curricular units 2nd sem' columns excluded as temporal leakage (used only in reference model E)

expectations.text: Sensitive attributes (at least Gender, Age at enrollment, Nacionality, Debtor or Tuition fees up to date) are not used as model features
expectations.evidence: notes.md keeps Age, Marital status, parents' occupation/qualification, Scholarship holder, Displaced and special needs as model features; only Gender/Nationality/International excluded

expectations.text: report.md compares the model against a simple baseline (e.g. a single-feature rule or prior-only model)
expectations.evidence: report table compares with 'chỉ dữ liệu tuyển sinh' and simple rule 'tỷ lệ môn đạt HK1' (67%)

expectations.text: report.md states the recall (share of dropouts caught) when flagging about 30% of students
expectations.evidence: report: catches about 69% of dropouts when meeting top 30% per cohort

expectations.text: A fairness check reports a metric (recall or flag rate) separately for at least one demographic group
expectations.evidence: fairness table by gender, age band, scholarship, displaced, evening study (recall, precision, flag rate)

expectations.text: report.md frames findings as associations/screening (not causal) and requires human (advisor) review before contacting students
expectations.evidence: report: 'Mô hình chỉ dự báo, không giải thích nguyên nhân'; recommends not labelling students and showing advisors rank only (human use) - returned as message text because the subagent could not write report.md
